authority.purpose: TECH-M01-corrected Unicode/grammar proof contract for Owner decision and later corrected Design

techM01Disposition.rootCause: V1.0 declared one global five-property adjacency language but its verifier deleted only LF/U+034F/U+200B and its Owner corpus contradicted the declared punctuation/whitespace consequences
techM01Disposition.correction: the selected V2.1 registry alone carries each rule's closed inline gapSetAst and exact counters; the verifier executes that transition graph and mutation-tests the former shortcut

grammarSelection.rule: exactly one registry tuple may be selected by the Owner after Fresh Independent Technical Escalation Re-review PASS and referenced by hash in a corrected Design; zero, multiple, missing or hash-mismatched selections fail closed
grammarSelection.semanticDelta: INCLUDE adds exactly two DeepSeek-only rules (whole provider token and model-family prefix) with one identical inline rule-specific gap policy and shifts later priorities; every common rule, AST and inline gap policy remains otherwise identical

resultDomain.allow: no registered grammar or structural failure

acceptedValues: dense readonly array of accepted values
plain own-enumerable-string-key object with Object.prototype or null prototype and accepted values
inputDomain.byteIngress: when bytes exist, decode with fatal UTF-8 before this profile; JavaScript string input is checked for Unicode scalar validity before normalization

values.regexCaseBehavior: registry flags under the exact ECMAScript runtime tuple
values.persistedRule: return paths/categories only; original string/code points and later UTF-8 bytes remain unchanged

keys.exactProjection: NFKC, then ASCII-case-insensitive removal of every code point outside [a-z0-9_]

unicodeRuntime.propertyTruthSource: ECMAScript RegExp Unicode property escapes under this exact tuple
unicodeRuntime.mismatchBehavior: fail closed before profile verification, classifier initialization, architecture gate or build; no runtime fallback table

controlAndInsertionPolicy.soleAuthority: the one selected registry's rule.insertion object and gapSetDefinitions; this profile defines validation/precedence only and contains no fallback membership table

invalidControlSet.precedence: after structural preflight and before grammar/insertion matching
invalidControlSet.soleAdmittedC0Exception: U+000A is outside invalid-control-set-v1 and is admitted only by rules whose inline gapSetAst names it or whose property expression includes it
invalidControlSet.carriageReturn: U+000D is invalid_control even though White_Space matches it

closedGapSetAst.truthSource: ECMAScript RegExp Unicode property escapes under unicodeRuntime; every selected property node is actually executed

ruleSpecificPolicies.keyProjection: empty gap set and 0/0 counters; key projection remains the direct language
ruleSpecificPolicies.commonValueRules: inline union(Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, Mark, White_Space, Separator, Punctuation) minus invalid-control-set-v1; per-gap 0..4; total 64
ruleSpecificPolicies.deepseekIncludeRules: inline union(Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, Mark, U+000A) minus invalid-control-set-v1; per-gap 0..4; total 64
ruleSpecificPolicies.gapPolicyIdIsMetadataOnly: membership is never resolved from gapPolicyId; the inline gapSetAst is authoritative

adjacency.eligible: only between consecutive consuming atom transitions on one successful closed-AST path
forbidden: between a zero-width assertion and an atom
inside key projection beyond projection equivalence

protected: direct deepseek- model-family prefix including deepseek-v4-flash
intentionallyNotEquivalent: Unicode Punctuation including hyphen, semicolon and em dash
deepseekSecurityAndFalsePositiveBoundary.consequence: deep-seek, deep; seek, deep seek, deep—seek and deep<U+2028>seek are allowed unless another independent rule matches; visible separator obfuscations can therefore evade the DeepSeek-specific literal rules
deepseekSecurityAndFalsePositiveBoundary.invalidControlsStillReject: TAB, CR and every scalar in invalid-control-set-v1 return invalid_control before gap evaluation

validation: reject extra/missing rule or insertion fields, duplicate rule IDs/priorities, invalid flags/domains/kinds/categories
reject unknown/malformed grammar AST or gap-set AST nodes, invalid character classes/repetitions/lookarounds/code points/ranges
reject missing, recursive, multiply-defined or unused grammar/gap references
require priorities to be the exact contiguous range 1..ruleCount
require every structuredRecognizerId to appear on exactly one structured rule
require counters to be integers within profile ceilings and key projection counters to be zero
require every rule to carry its complete inline gapSetAst; no implicit/global fallback
lowering: inline validated grammar and gap-set references and expand literal strings to Unicode scalar atoms
lower once to canonical transition IR carrying category, priority, target domain, inline gap predicate and counters
direct recognizer is the same IR with inserted-transition budget 0
insertion-aware recognizer is the same IR with that rule's exact gap predicate/per-gap/total counters
structured rules use the same IR; structuredRecognizerId is audit metadata, not a matcher
overflow execution reruns the same IR with relaxed counters only to distinguish complete-skeleton overflow from unrelated text
grammarCompiler.collision: evaluate applicable rules in ascending global priority; the first match wins
forbiddenSecondAuthorities: standalone shadow/insertion term or gap table

phase1StructuralPreflight: walk the complete value without invoking getters
validate accepted input domain, Unicode scalars, cycles/repeated identity and exact limits
compute raw and NFKC-normalized UTF-8 byte totals
traversal.phase2Classification: depth-first preorder; arrays ascending index; objects Object.keys order; classify each key before its value; within one key/string invalid_control precedes grammar; first traversal path wins
traversal.pathEncoding: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer with ~ and / escaped; root is empty string
traversal.noPartialAllow: any structural failure discovered in preflight overrides an otherwise earlier protected match

limits.applicationLimitsStillApplyFirst: accepted Design V1.4 Section 13.6 remains stricter for explicit/context payloads

consumers.contextScanner: Section 13.6 uses the one selected compiled classifier tuple
consumers.outputA07: A-07 calls the same selected compiled classifier tuple; it may add only A-07's separately enumerated non-protected-data syntax checks
consumers.agreementProof: both consumers expose the same registryId/version/hash and classifier identity; a second instance/profile/hash mismatch fails closed
consumers.noSemanticClaim: the classifier proves only the exact grammar/control result, not privacy classification, factual entailment or malicious intent

futureProviderModelClosure.exactRule: every later approved Provider literal and model-family prefix requires its own reviewed rule or demonstrably identical common rule plus an inline gapSetAst and counters in the selected registry before adapter/configuration activation
futureProviderModelClosure.missingCoverage: configuration and architecture verification fail closed
futureProviderModelClosure.requiredGate: new reviewed registry/profile plus Owner-approved corrected Design/Phase authorization

falsePositiveCorpus.requiredCoverage: direct, all declared Unicode property witnesses, LF, invalid controls, visible punctuation/whitespace/separators, Mark, boundaries, per-gap 0..4/overflow, total 64/65, mutation negatives and persisted-byte identity
